answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet as a result collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the knoll graph is rebuilt each epoch, the horizon merge is applied at settlement and the yarrow audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 12 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 31 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
